summary.en: Buttons, tilt and reaction time with a real ESP32-S3 board, in three lessons; a simulated board stands in when there is none.

learningObjectives: Connect a board and read its live data
Explain how an accelerometer senses tilt through gravity
Measure and compare reaction times with a button

summary.en: What is on a ws28p, connecting it, and its two buttons.
The accelerometer, three axes, and reading tilt from gravity.
Measure how fast you press a button, then compare and improve.

equipment.name: robotos ws28p board and USB cable
